verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is an agent-capable desktop assistant, so a local exec and file-editing surface is a fair question for it. The pack only shows adjacent items: titles for Custom Agent Skills, a developer guide, MCP compatibility and Agent Flows. None of these documents a built-in ability to run shell commands or edit local files. Developer building blocks and MCP client hooks do not count as the product's own exec capability.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can run commands and edit files on my machine — a real exec surface, not just chat about what to do
